verdict.rationale: The IRS runs online services that hold user data, so a policy or control on using that data for AI training is a fair privacy question to ask. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, policy, or control. The ID.me note that biometric data is automatically deleted is a related data-retention practice, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
